summary: {employee} practices taking a relay call before a resident needs the service.
realLife: Merced committed to training appropriate employees to place and receive calls through California Relay Service and to report who received the training.
gates: A county office receives public calls and has a relay training session scheduled.
inGame: needs: the office's public phone service and staff training roster.

turns.what: The supervisor arranges a practice call on the next shift.
turns.pulledBy: The relief worker misses the session.
turns.writesBack: The training roster carries an outstanding name.

turns.pulledBy: The employee completes a call in each direction.
turns.writesBack: The completion entry names the employee.
